name: cn.dekuple/dekuple-china
title: Dekuple China
description: Dekuple China (digital marketing & GEO agency): services, insights, open jobs, enquiries.

tools.name: about_dekuple
tools.description:
Who Dékuple China is: company, group, offices, contact, and the list of services with links.
    公司介绍：主体、集团、地址、联系方式和全部服务列表。

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' for English, 'zh' for Simplified Chinese.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: get_service
tools.description:
One service in full: what it covers, how it works, FAQs. `slug` comes from about_dekuple.
    某项服务的完整介绍（slug 见 about_dekuple）。

slug.description: Service slug, taken from the `services` list returned by about_dekuple, e.g. 'geo'.
slug.title: Slug

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' for English, 'zh' for Simplified Chinese.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description:
Search Dékuple China's Insights articles (GEO, AI search, SEO/SEM, SCRM, WeChat, China platforms).
    Returns the best matches with summary and link; read one with get_insight.
    搜索洞察文章，返回标题、摘要和链接。

query.description: Keywords to search for, in the same language as `lang`, e.g. 'Baidu indexing' or '百度收录'.
query.title: Query

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' for English, 'zh' for Simplified Chinese.
lang.title: Lang

limit.description: How many articles to return (1-10; larger values are capped at 10).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description:
Read one Insights article in full (sections, FAQs, sources). `slug` comes from search_insights.
    读取一篇洞察文章全文。

slug.description: Article slug from a search_insights result, e.g. 'how-to-measure-geo-results'. Use the same `lang` as the search.
slug.title: Slug

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' for English, 'zh' for Simplified Chinese.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description:
Open positions at Dékuple China with the main facts and the link to apply.
    在招职位。

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' for English, 'zh' for Simplified Chinese.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: china_llm_sources
tools.description:
Which websites Chinese LLMs (DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Tencent Yuanbao) actually cite in their answers,
    by industry and platform: the share of each source type (brand sites, trade media, portals, social, e-commerce,
    academic, government) and the 20 most-cited third-party sites. First-hand data from Dékuple China's own query
    runs (tens of thousands of citations), useful for GEO: where to publish so Chinese AI answers cite you.
    中文大模型（DeepSeek、豆包、千问、元宝）回答时实际引用哪些网站：按行业和平台看来源类型占比和引用最多的 20 个第三方网站。

industry.description: Industry of the questions, or 'all'. E.g. 'automotive', 'chemicals-materials', 'finance'.
industry.title: Industry

platform.description: Chinese LLM: deepseek, doubao (豆包, ByteDance), qianwen (千问 / Qwen, Alibaba), yuanbao (元宝, Tencent), or 'all'.
platform.title: Platform

tools.name: china_llm_source_profile
tools.description:
How often Chinese LLMs cite one website: citations per platform (DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Yuanbao), its rank
    among all cited third-party sites, and the industries it is cited for. Use it to judge whether a media outlet
    or platform is worth publishing on for GEO in China. Covers sites with at least 20 citations in the study.
    某个网站被中文大模型引用的情况：各平台引用次数、总排名、主要被引用的行业。

site.description: Site name or domain as Chinese LLMs cite it, e.g. '知乎专栏', '搜狐', '百度百科', 'zhihu.com', 'sohu.com'. Partial names work.
site.title: Site

tools.name: china_search_suggestions
tools.description:
What Chinese users actually type around a keyword: the search-box dropdown suggestions (下拉词) that
    Baidu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Zhihu show for it, collected daily by Dékuple China's crawler since May 2026.
    Use it to understand user intent and long-tail questions per platform, and to write GEO prompts or content
    that match how people search in China. If the exact keyword was never crawled, returns stored suggestions
    that contain it.
    中国用户围绕某个词实际搜什么：百度、抖音、小红书、知乎的搜索下拉词（Dékuple China 每日抓取）。

keyword.description: A Chinese keyword or short phrase (2-30 characters), e.g. '跑步', '鸿蒙系统', '离婚财产分割'. Search suggestions are mostly in Chinese, so pass the Chinese term.
keyword.title: Keyword

platform.description: baidu, douyin (抖音), xiaohongshu (小红书), zhihu (知乎), or 'all' for the four side by side.
platform.title: Platform

limit.description: Maximum suggestions per platform (1-50; larger values are capped at 50).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description:
Send an enquiry to the Dékuple China team, exactly like the contact form. Only when the user asked
    to contact Dékuple China and confirmed the details. category: geo (GEO / AI search), seo (SEO/SEM),
    social (WeChat & social), scrm (SCRM & automation), data (dashboards & insight), brand (brand & website),
    other. budget (per year, optional): lt10 (< RMB 100k), 10-30, 30-100, gt100 (> RMB 1M).
    提交咨询（等同官网表单），仅在用户明确要求并确认信息后调用。

name.description: The user's full name, as they gave it (2-60 characters). Never invent it.
name.title: Name

company.description: The user's company or organisation (2-100 characters).
company.title: Company

email.description: The user's work email; the team replies to this address.
email.title: Email

message.description: What the user needs, in their own words (10-2000 characters): goals, market, timing.
message.title: Message

category.description: Main topic: geo (GEO / AI search), seo (SEO/SEM), social (WeChat & social), scrm (SCRM & automation), data (dashboards & insight), brand (brand & website), other.
category.title: Category

phone.description: Optional phone number with country code, e.g. '+86 138 0000 0000'. Digits, spaces and + - ( ) only.
phone.title: Phone

budget.description: Optional yearly budget: lt10 (< RMB 100k), 10-30 (RMB 100-300k), 30-100 (RMB 300k-1M), gt100 (> RMB 1M); empty if unknown.
budget.title: Budget

lang.description: Language of the enquiry and of the team's reply: 'en' or 'zh'.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
Open 1-hour meeting slots with the Dékuple China team (Shanghai time), within the next 3 weeks.
    Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; leave them empty for the whole window. The answer includes today's date and the
    dates of next week's Mon-Fri, so you can turn "next Tuesday" into a date. Then call book_meeting.
    查询可预约的会议时段（上海时间，1 小时一档，未来 3 周内）；结果附带今天和下周一到周五的日期。

date_from.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD (Shanghai time). Empty = today.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Last day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = end of the 3-week window.
date_to.title: Date To

part_of_day.description: Only morning slots (before 12:00), only afternoon slots, or any.
part_of_day.title: Part Of Day

lang.description: Language of the slot labels and host roles: 'zh' or 'en'.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description:
Book a meeting with the Dékuple China team in a slot from check_availability (`start` like
    "2026-12-01 10:00", Shanghai time). Only when the user asked for the meeting and confirmed the slot,
    their name, company and email; never invent contact details. meeting_type: monthly_review (existing
    client's monthly meeting), intro, workshop, other. The booking is pending until the team confirms.
    预约会议（时段来自 check_availability），仅在用户明确要求并确认时间和联系方式后调用；团队确认后生效。

start.description: Slot start exactly as returned by check_availability, e.g. '2026-12-01 10:00' (Shanghai time).
start.title: Start

name.description: The user's full name, as they gave it (2-60 characters). Never invent it.
name.title: Name

company.description: The user's company or organisation (2-100 characters).
company.title: Company

email.description: The user's work email; the team replies to this address.
email.title: Email

meeting_type.description: monthly_review (an existing client's monthly meeting), intro (first conversation), workshop, or other.
meeting_type.title: Meeting Type

topic.description: Short subject of the meeting, up to 300 characters, e.g. 'GEO for our China website'.
topic.title: Topic

mode.description: online (video call) or office (at the Shanghai office).
mode.title: Mode

phone.description: Optional phone number with country code, e.g. '+86 138 0000 0000'. Digits, spaces and + - ( ) only.
phone.title: Phone

note.description: Optional extra context for the team, up to 1000 characters.
note.title: Note

host.description: Host key from check_availability's `hosts[].host`, matching the slot chosen.
host.title: Host
